title: DSC 106 Lab 4: Data and APIs
description: Loads this portfolio's projects from a shared JSON file and renders them with reusable JavaScript. Fetches GitHub profile statistics and shows the latest projects on the home page.

title: DSC 106 Lab 3: JavaScript
description: Adds shared navigation, current-page highlighting, and a light and dark theme menu to this portfolio. Saves the theme choice in localStorage and encodes the contact form's mailto link.

title: DSC 106 Lab 2: CSS
description: Styles the portfolio with a responsive project grid, aligned cards using CSS subgrid, flexible navigation, and a résumé timeline. Uses shared color tokens and responsive spacing across the site.

title: Law-Di-Gras Case Dashboard
description: A hackathon dashboard for reviewing case tasks, waiting parties, and their source evidence. Includes selected provider views and a public demo with fictional cases.

title: DSC 106 Lab 1: HTML Portfolio
description: Builds the foundation of this personal website with semantic HTML: a home page, project gallery, contact form, and résumé. Publishes the portfolio through GitHub Pages.

title: Tempo of the Game
description: Analyzes professional League of Legends match data from Oracle's Elixir to compare regional leagues by combined kills per minute. Includes exploratory visualizations, missingness analysis, a permutation test, and win prediction from 15-minute statistics.

title: Job Application Automation
description: AI agents drive a browser through job applications from start to finish, with a separate handler for Greenhouse, Workday, Oracle, and Ashby. Built with Python and Chrome DevTools.

title: RideWatch
description: Tracks how reliable public transit is by comparing GTFS Realtime feeds against published schedules. It has a live vehicle map and delay history for each stop. Built with Go, PostgreSQL, and MapLibre.

title: Canvas Updates for macOS
description: A local macOS project that checks Canvas for new grades, assignments, announcements, and approaching deadlines. Compares updates against saved SQLite state and supports notifications and questions through iMessage.

title: On-Call Agent
description: An incident response project that gathers recent commits, service logs, and runbooks after an alert. Produces an incident brief and a postmortem, with a demo service and injected fault scenarios for evaluation.

title: Wildfire Risk GIS Pipeline
description: A geospatial feature engineering project that turns OpenStreetMap data into grid-level measurements of vegetation, roads, buildings, and distance to water. Exports CSV, GeoJSON, and GeoParquet datasets for further analysis.

title: Lightning Data Pipeline
description: A real time pipeline that decodes Blitzortung's compressed WebSocket feed, stores the lightning strikes in PostgreSQL, and serves them through a FastAPI REST API. Built with Python, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, and Docker.
